comparison.objective: Seat, orient and depress a French-press plunger safely; candidate sifts ceramic media away from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Coaxial lid insertion, rotational spout closure, force/speed-controlled plunging and vessel stabilization versus bimanual screen grasping, agitation and support replacement.
comparison.success_condition: Seated lid, closed spout, ≥52 mm seated plunge, upright carafe and hazard-free release versus ≥98% recovery with all washers retained and screen reseated.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual stabilization and force control are generic primitives; the record tests guided assembly and fluid-safe plunging rather than size-selective separation.
